title: Zesty Australian Egg Custard
description: A salty, fluffy midnight snack that combines creamy egg custard with steamed greens, perfect for the Whole30 lifestyle.
instructions: Steam 200 g of greens in a steamer basket until just tender, about 3 minutes, then set aside.
Whisk together 4 eggs, 120 ml coconut milk, 1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, and 1/4 tsp garlic powder until smooth.
Pour custard mixture into a 9-inch shallow baking dish lined with parchment.
Spread steamed greens evenly over the custard and lightly press them down.
Drizzle 1 tbsp coconut oil over the greens and custard.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and bake another 5 minutes until custard is firm and lightly browned.
